title: patch_file rejects files read via read_file_range
description: Two patch_file calls failed with 'error applying hunk' on files that had been read only via read_file_range rather than full read_file. The tool scope guard accepted read_file_range as a read, but patch_file's context matching failed, requiring write_file fallbacks. This inflated tool-errors count.
proposed_resolution: Clarify in run.skill.md that patch_file requires a full read_file read, not only read_file_range. Alternatively, update patch_file's scope enforcement to require full-file reads.

title: Pre-existing test standard_registry_has_ten_tools blocks all-tests-pass
description: The test expects 18 tools in the standard registry but 19 are registered. This was failing before this run at baseline ebe1852. Every run targeting this codebase will fail all-tests-pass until this test is updated.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to update standard_registry_has_ten_tools to match the current tool count (19), keeping the test name and structure but correcting the hardcoded value.

title: Missing moeb tool: cargo build/test runner
description: Used Bash to invoke cargo build --release and cargo test. No moeb tool exists for running build or test commands. This forces moeb-tool-origin to fail on every run that includes Step 6 (Build and test).
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a run_command moeb tool (or cargo-specific tool) covering cargo build and cargo test invocation from a specified directory.

title: Missing moeb tool: git baseline verification
description: Used Bash to run git stash, stash drop, checkout, status, and log to confirm a test failure was pre-existing. No moeb tool exists for git read operations (status, log, diff) outside the write-oriented tools already present.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a git_status or git_log moeb tool for read-only git queries needed during verification phases.

title: Rubric score degraded below rolling baseline
description: Current rubric_score is more than 0.10% below the rolling average. Estimated score: 0.786 (11 pass / 14 scored). Rolling average from last valid baseline: 0.9545. Failures: tool-errors (patch_file scope mismatch), moeb-tool-origin (Bash for cargo/git), all-tests-pass (pre-existing test failure).
proposed_resolution: Revert to the git tag preceding this run, create a diagnostic spec identifying the regression cause, and branch from the pre-regression version.
